<p><strong>1. EBITDA Multiple (earnings-:
1. EBITDA Multiple (lokusekelwe kwinzuzo): Lokusebentisana kakhulu emabhizinisini asebentako. Inani = EBITDA × luphindvo lwemboni. Ku-SME yase-SA luphindvo lusekhatsi kwa 2-5× EBITDA (vs 8-15× emabhizinisini labaliwe). Lifemu yezinjiniya lenenzuzo ene R2m EBITDA ingatsengiswa nge R6-8m (3-4× EBITDA). Tintfo letikhuphula luphindvo: imali engenayo levuselelwako, basebentisi labahlukahlukene, timu yetinhloko letinganciki kumnikazi, luhlelo lwekukhula lolucinile.

2. Discounted Cash Flow (DCF): Hlola imali yamahhala yesikhatsi lesitako, yehlisa ngelinga lelingoti (WACC). Kulungile kakhulu ngokwetiyori kodwa kuyazwela ekucabangeni. Kusetjentiselwa ikakhulu amabhizinisi lamakhulu nobe ngabeluleki betimali ngesikhathi sekuhlola.

3. Net Asset Value (NAV): Impahla isusa tikweleti ngemali yemakethe. Kusetjentiselwa amabhizinisi lasedluleyo ngetinsiza (tinkhamini temhlaba, timayini, tekukhiqiza). Kanengi inani laphansi, libhizinisi lelisasebenta kufanele libe nenani lelikhulu kunetincenye talo.
<p><strong>1. Harvesting losses:</strong:
1. Kuvuna kulahleka: Uma unokulahleka lokungakhonjiswa kuphothifoliyo yakho, kukhiphe ngomnyaka wetimali ofana nenzuzo lenkhulu. Kulahleka kuhlanganisa inzuzo randi ngerandi ngembik kwekusebenta kwesilinganiso sekufaka.

2. Kusabalalisa kutsiwa ngeminyaka yetimali: Kukhishwa kweminyaka yonkhe kusetjentiswa-no-kulahleka. Uma uhlela kutsengisa indzawo lenkhulu, kuhlanganisa kutsengisa ngeminyaka leminyenti kusebentisa R40 000 tekukhipha.

3. Isikhwama se-TFSA: Impahla lesemkhatsini we-Tax-Free Savings Account inezero CGT, phakade. Kubamba impahla lekhulako (equity ETFs) ku-TFSA yakho kususa i-CGT kulempahla phakade.

4. Kupha ku-PBO: Kupha impahla lenentsengo ngqo kuSigungu Sekuhlomisa lesiNgcolile seSigaba 18A akukhokhelwa i-CGT futsi kukhipha imali yetimali leyingaphansi kuze kufike ku 10% wemali engenayo yetimali.
<p><strong>1. Inter vivos trust:</strong:
1. Itrust ya inter vivos: Dlulisa impahla lekhulako iye etrust manje. Kukhula kweluviviyo kuwela ngaphandle kwelifa lakho. Lokudlulisa kusebenta i-CGT manje (tindleko tesikhatsi sinye) kodwa kususa kukhula lokuhlala kukubala kwemsebenzi welifa.

2. Umshuwalense wemali (Sigaba 3(3)(a)): Umgomo wemali lapho lifa lingu mazuza kufakiwe elifeni lelikhokhiswako kodwa umshwalense ukhokha umsebenzi. Le migomo yakhelwe kukhokha umsebenzi welifa, tindleko tikhokhela kusengaphambili umsebenzi wakho welifa ngetigatshana.

3. Kupha kwekwendza kute kwandziswe: Kuhlela intsandvo yakho kuze lifa lonkhe liye kumlingani wakho kuyacoca wonkhe umsebenzi ekufeni kwesibili, ngesikhathi lapho kwehla kungashintsha, nobe lifa lomlingani lasesaphila lingahlelwa ngenyenye indlela.

4. Kupha ngesikhathi sekusebenta: Tipho kuze kufike ku R100 000/ngumnyaka atidzingi intselo yetipho. Ngeminyaka leminyaka lengu-20, Riyamangala R2 tigidi lingadluliselwa ngaphandle kwelifa lakho, kusindzisa R400 000 emsebentini welifa.
<p><strong>1. Sole Proprietor:</strong>:
1. Umnikazi Lodvwa: Kute kwehlukana emkhatsini wakho nebhizinisi. Yonkhe inzuzo ikhokhiswa imali yetimali (kuze kufike ku 45%). Umtwalo wemali longapheli wemuntfu. Tindleko tekucala ti-zero. Kusebenta kubabhemi labangaphansi kwe-R1m kutfululwa.

2. Inkampani Yamuntfu (Pty Ltd): Sigungu semthethweni lesehlukile. 27% wesilinganiso setimali senkampani. Kuvikela umtwalo wemali wemuntfu (lokhawukile). Kudzinga kubhaliswa kwe-CIPC. Kulungele amabhizinisi langetulu kwe-R500k kutfululwa.

3. Umboneleli Wetisebenti Temuntfu (PSP): I-Pty Ltd lapho 80%+ wemali engenayo ivela kutisebenti kumuntu munye nobe lababili. SARS ikhokhisa i-PSP ngebubanzi ba 28-45% (hhayi 27% wesilinganiso senkampani), lena yicuwo lenyenti yetisebenti letiwela kuyo.

4. Sigungu Sebhizinisi Lelincane (SBC): I-Pty Ltd lefanele timali letinciphile. Imali yencenye engaphansi kwe-R20 tigidi. Kute umnikazi wetabelo longaba netabelo kwenye inkampani. Isilinganiso setimali: 0% kucala ku-R95 750, bese iba ngu 7%-27% ngetiteji. Kubabhizinisi labafanele, loku kusindzisa imali lenyenti.

<p><strong>Anchoring:</strong> the first:
Kuhlanganisa ngentengo yekucala (Anchoring): intengo yekucala oyibonako itsintsha indlela ohlulela ngayo onkhe amanani emva kwalo. Ijakhete ye-R5 000 yenta le-R2 000 ibonakale 'ishibhile'. Ngisho noma i-R2 000 iseyimali lenyenti.

Inkohliso yetindleko letikhokhwe kakadze (Sunk cost fallacy): kuchubeka nentfo ngesizatfu semali seyisetshenzisiwe, ngisho noma ingasacondzi. 'Ngikhokhele ijimu, ngakho ngizochubeka ngisho ngingayenti': uma kuqhathaniswa nekuyekela nekumisa lokumosha kwelikusasa. Imali seyaphela akufanele ize ihole sincumo sakho selandzelako.
<p><strong>Anchoring:</strong> When the:

Sunk cost fallacy: Kuchubeka nentfo ngesizatfu semali seyisetshenzisiwe, ngisho noma ingasacondzi. 'Sengisikhokhele sikhungo sejimu, ngako ngizoyisa ngisho ngiyayitsandza' vs. 'Sengisikhokhile, kodwa kufanele ngiyekele futsi ngimise kumosha timyanga telikusasa.'
<p><strong>Asset allocation</strong> (ho: Asset allocation (indlela ohlukanisa ngayo emkhatsini wetitsekiso, emabhondi, impahla nemali) iqhuba inengi lekwehlukana kwetinzuzo takho, kakhulu kunetitsekiso ozikhetsako. Vumela isikhatsi sakho sikubeke: imali ende ingathwala ingoti yetitsekiso, imali ledzingeka eminyakeni lemibili ayinakukwati. Inengi labatshali-mali base-SA libamba imvelo yangaphandle ngesizatfu sokuba umholo wakho, indlu kanye nemali sele yendzawo. <p><strong>Gross Profit Margin:</strong>:
Umkhawulu wenzuzo lenkhulu (Gross Profit Margin): (Imali engenako - Tilibeko teTimpahla letitsengisiwe) ÷ Imali engenako. Kukalwa lokugcinwako ngaphambi kwezindleko letinkhulu. Ibhizinisi letitsengisako leyi-25% yenzuzo kujwayelekile. Ibhizinisi lesofthiwe leyi-70%+ kujwayelekile. Kuqhathanise nesilinganiso semboni yakho.

Umkhawulu we-EBITDA: Imali engenako ngaphambi kwentalo, yentela, ukwehla kwenani, kanye nekuphungulwa ÷ Imali engenako. Isilinganiso lesicocile kakhulu senzuzo yekusebenza. Kusetshenziswa ekuhloleni amabhizinisi (bona sifundvo lesilandzelako).

Isilinganiso samanje (Current Ratio): Impahla yanyalo ÷ Sikweleti sanyalo. Ngetulu kwa-1.5 = kuphilile. Ngaphansi kwa-1 = ingoti lenkhulu yekungabi nemali, ungahle ungakwati kubhadala tibambiso eminyakeni le-12.

Onyaka wetikweleti (Debtor Days): (Batikweleti ÷ Imali engenako) × 365. Kutsi bathengi batsatsa sikhatsi esingakanani kubhadala. Emahola angu-30 kuyajwayeleka; 90+ emalanga kuyinkinga yemali. Onkhe emalanga etikweleti = imali lele kungabhadalwa.

Umkhawulu wenzuzo lecocile (Net Profit Margin): Inzuzeleco lecocile ÷ Imali engenako. Ngemuva kwato tonkhe tindlu kufaka phakathi yentela. Lamanye amabhizinisi laphilile: 8-20%.

<p><strong>Mental accounting</strong> is:
Kubala kwasemcondvweni kungumkhuba wekutfatsa imali ngendlela lehlukile kuye ngemvelaphi yayo noma injongo yayo, noma ngabe imali iyashintja (randi yinye ifana nanoma nguyiphi i-randi).

Tibonelo letijwayelekile:

  • Kusebentisa ibhonasi kakhulu kunemholo wenyanga ('yimali lengetulu')
  • Kubhadala intalo ekarini yesikweleti ngesikhatsi unemali lesongwe ku-akhawunti lenentalo lencane ('lemali yetimo tatizatata')
  • Kutfatsa imali yekugembula njengemali 'yamahhala' lezokusetjentiswa ngaphandle kwekucabangela
  • Kuba nebugovu ngemali yesandla kodwa ukhululeke ngekarini yesikweleti ('ayivakali njengemali yangempela')

Kubala kwasemcondvweni yikho okwenta bantfu babe nesikweleti lesibili lesibhebhetsekile futsi bagcine imali lenkhulu lenentalo lencane, lokuyinhlanganisela lengakahleleki kahle ngebendlela yetibalo.

Kubala kwasemcondvweni kukutfatsa imali ngendlela lehlukile kuye ngaphi lafike khona. Ibhonasi iyaphela ngesiviki kantsi inani elifanayo lemholo lihlelwe kahle ngebhajethi. Noma ngabe imali lesicitswa yi-SARS ibuyela nje njengentela yakho lebeyikhokhelwe kakhulu. Lolubandlululo luyenetisa netindleko tangempela: R20 000 esongweni ku-6% kanye ne-R20 000 ekarini ku-20% kubiza cishe R2 800 ngemnyaka. Uma isetjentiswa ngamabomu, ti-akhawunti temgomo letinamagama tentela lolubandlululo lutiphatsele wena.
<p><strong>Overconfidence bias:</strong>:
Kubandlululo lwekuzethemba kakhulu: Bantfu labanyenti batfola emakhono abo ekushayela, ekutjaleni imali, kanye nokuenta tincumo njengalabadlula lizinga 'leliphakeme', lokungenteki ngebubhalo kubantfu labanyenti. Ekutjaleni imali, kutsetsemba kakhulu kwenta kutsi kuthengiswe kakhulu, kunganakekelwa kakhulu, kanye nekutfatsa bungoti lobunyenti kunekukhona kwakho kwangempela.

Luphenyo lwetemicabango lukhombisa njalo kutsi batjalimali labangaphandle labathengisa ngemandla batfola imbuyiso lenkhulu lembi, ngoba tindleko tekusebenta kanye nesimo sekuthenga okuphezulu/kuthengisa phansi tiyakhuphuka ngesikhatsi. Batjalimali labangasebenti kakhulu (labangenalutfo lwenetiwako) bavame kudlula batjalimali labakhutsele.

Kubandlululo lwesikhatsi lesisandza kucala: Ingcondvo ibeka tisefo tesikhatsi lesisandza kucala kakhulu futsi icabanga kutsi tintfo talonyaka titawuchubeka. <p><strong>Overconfidence</strong> makes: Kuzethemba kakhulu kwenta bantfu bathengise kakhulu, futsi kuthengisa lokunyenti kwehlisa imbuyiso. Kubandlululo lwesikhatsi lesisandza kucala kusenta sicabange kutsi iminyaka lembalwa leyendlile itawuchubeka phakade. Kulungisa kulingana kwema-equity emva kwekugijima, noma kulahla timakethe emva kwemphetsolo. Kubandlululo lwekucabanga ngemuva kwabe sekusicinisekisa kutsi sabona kusengaphambili, sakha kutsemba lokungekho. <p>SA's current account deficit (importi:

Uma imitengo yetintfo lenani inyuka (igolide, platina, ikholomu), imivuzo yetiphumako te-SA iyenyuka, yehlisa ukushoda kwe-akhawunti yesikhashana futsi iseke i-land. Loku kungangoba imitengo yetintfo temayini kanye nelandi kuhlobene kakhulu.
<p>SARS eFiling (efiling.sars.gov.za) an: I-SARS eFiling (efiling.sars.gov.za) kanye ne-SARS MobiApp kuvumela bantfu kutsi bafake tibuyiso tetinhlawulo ku-inthanethi. <p>SARS gives individuals two major CGT:
I-SARS iniketa bantfu tivikelo tetinhlawulo te-CGT letimbili letinkhulu:

Susa samnyaka: R40 000. Kucala kwa-R40 000 wetinzuzo tekutfolwa noma kulahlekelwa akunanelwa ngumnyaka. Nakufa, loku kenyukela ku-R300 000.

Susa sendlu yekuhlala: R2 wemiliyoni, Inzuzo ekuthengiseni indlu yakho lenkhulu. Uma uthengisa nga-R3.5m wafike watenga nga-R1.2m (inzuzo = R2.3m), ngu-R300 000 kuphela loneluhlawulo ngemuva kwekususa kwa-R2m. Indlu bekufanele ibe yindlu yakho lenkhulu futsi itsandvete kakhulu ngetizatfu tekuhlala.

Kuhlanganisiwe, umnikati wendlu wamaminithi ekusebenta ku-45% kwenzuzo ya-R2.3m ukhokha i-CGT ku-R260 000 kuphela ngemuva kwekususa kwombili, inhlawulo ephumelelayo cishe ya-R46 800, hhayi R207 000 enzuzweni yonkhe.
<p>SARS is explicit: crypto is a taxable: I-SARS icacile: i-crypto luhlobo loluhlulekile lwetimali. Gcina imibhalo yetento tonkhe: lusuku, inani lelandi uma utenga, inani lelandi uma uthengisa. Emahwebo ase-SA (Luno, VALR) abelana data ne-SARS.

<p>SARS takes exactly what you owe, but:
I-SARS ithatha loko okweletako kahle, kodvwvwa ayitjeli ngemigaqo semthethweni yekukhokha kancane. Basebenti bangati ngemikhawulo ye-RA, tibusiso tetempilo kanye nemikhawulo yasekhaya bakhokha kakhulu ngetigidzi minyaka yonkhe.

Likhubalo loti kukhupha kunganciphisa imali yakho yekutfula alinakwenzeka. Uhlala ungetela kakhulu ngokutfolwa okukhulu.
<p>SARS taxes trusts punitively to preve:
I-SARS ihlawulisa titrust ngendlela letfusa kuvimbela bantfu labacebile kutsi bafake imali kuletitrust ngetinga letiphansi:

  • Inholo legcinwe kutrust: Inhlawulo isisekelweni sa-45%, ifana nelizinga lelisetulu lelifanako
  • Tinzuzo tekutfolwa kutrust: 80% lizinga lekufaka × 45% = 36% lephumelelayo
  • Inholo lekhishwe kubasizakaleli: Inhlawulo isebenta ezandleni zomuzuzakaleli ngelizinga lakho

Lithuba lelihle lekuhlela: Uma unnabantfu labakhulile noma umfati/umyeni ngetinga letiphansi, ukukhishwa kwenholo kusuka kutrust kubo kuhlawuliswa ngelizinga labo (kungaba yi-18% noma 26%), hhayi 45%. Loku kusemthethweni kuhlaba inholo futsi kungasindzisa inhlawulo lenkhulu ngumnyaka.
<p>SARS wants your certificates imported:
I-SARS ifuna titifiketi takho tingeniswe ekubuyisweni kwe-eFiling yakho. IRP5 / IT3(a): isitifiketi somcashi wakho semholo, tincome kanye ne-PAYE, lesikhishwe ekupheleni kwemnyaka. IT3(b): inholo yentalo esuka ebangeni lakho noma etimalini (ngaphansi kwa-65, i-R23 800 yekucala yentalo ngumnyaka ikhululekile). IT3(c): tinzuzo tekutfolwa kusuka emashemeni, kuma-ETF nasema-unit trust, kusuka esiteji sakho setimali.

Ku-eFiling, 'Import Certificate' igcwalisa tibuyiso takho ngokwenteke ngetinkampani nababeki, kodvwa hlola solo kutsi tinombolo letingenisiwe tihambelana naloko lokutfole ngempela, futsi gcina imibhalo yakho okungenani iminyaka lemihlanu.

<p>The <strong>FAIS Ombud</strong> (the:
I-FAIS Ombud (Ombud yetisebenti tetimali) ichazulula tikhalo tewakhi kubafaki-zicelo / bameli ngekubulungisa, ngenhlonipho nangalokuphutfumako. Ombud angaphenyisisa, acatulule aphinde ente sincumo lesinemiphumela yomyalo wetintsimba.

Emandla e-Ombud etimali alinganiselwe: angawongela sincesete kuze kube yi-R3.5 yezigidi ngesikhalo sinye (umfaki-zicelo angayekela imali lephezu kwaloku kuze ahlale emandleni).

Qaphela: Imitsetfo ye-Ombud Council leyacala kusebenta nga-1 Julayi 2024 yenyusa lizinga kusuka ku-R800 000 kuya ku-R3 500 000. Izibonelo tekufundza ticale tisho i-R800 000 - tibalo tanyalo tiyi-R3.5 yezigidi.
<p>The <strong>FAIS Ombud</strong> resol: I-FAIS Ombud ichazulula tikhalo tewakhi futsi yenta tincumo letinemiphumela yomyalo wetintsimba, kuze kube yi-R3.5 yezigidi (leyanyuswa kusuka ku-R800 000 nga-1 Julayi 2024). Khala kuqala ku-FSP (tiviki letintsatfu), bese kuba tinyanga letitfupha ku-Ombud; Ombud angala tindzaba letindzala kunati tinyawo letintsatfu.
<p>The <strong>Financial Advisory and In:
Umtshelo Weteluleko Tetimali Nemiseko Yekulamula 37 wa-2002 (FAIS) ukhona kuvikela bafaki-zicelo nabamukela teluleko tetimali nobe miseko yekulamula. Lokwenta ngekucaphela bantfu ne-mabhizinisi labanikela ngaleyomiseko.

Tinhloso taco letinkulu: kwenta umkhakha ube ngowebungcweti, kuqinisekisa kutsi bafaki-zicelo batfola teluleko letifanele, kunika umnikelo kuze bafaki-zicelo bente tincumo letilungile, nekunika bafaki-zicelo indzawo yekukhala (i-FAIS Ombud).

I-FAIS ilawula kutiphatsa - indlela libhizinisi lelenteka ngayo - hhayi imitento yetimali uqobo.

<p>The <strong>real interest rate</stron:
Lizinga lentalo langempela = lizinga lelingakalungiswa - lizinga lekwehla kwemali. Loku yimali yakho leyitfolako ngempela emva kwekutsi lizinga lekwehla kwemali lidle amandla ekutsenga.

Sibonelo: I-akhawunti yakho yekonga ikhadla 9%. Lizinga lekwehla kwemali ngu-5.5%. Imbuyiselo yakho yangempela yi-3.5%, ngulokho umnotfo wakho lotfola ngako emandleni ekutsenga.

Malizinga langempela langanakeki: Nangabe lizinga lekwehla kwemali leqa lizinga lakho lekonga, emandla akho ekutsenga ayanciphisa ngisho nalapho ibhalansi yakho yemarandi ikhula. Nga-2020-2021, malizinga aseNingizimu Afrika abeseduze neze nobe alusizi, imali yemarandi beyilulahla inani layo.

Kwakhiwa kwemnotfo wesikhatsi leside, udinga imitento lephumelela njalo ekwehleni kwemali ngesikhatsi. Loku kungumcondvo wencenye yekutjala imali etabelweni kunekugcina tonkhe tingalo etimalini.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> (repur:
Lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako (lizinga lokubuyisa) lilizinga lentalo lapho iBhange LaseNingizimu Afrika (SARB) liboleka khona imali ebusuku emabhibhini ehwebelwano. Leli lilungelo lelisekuhleni lelisetjentiswa yi-SARB kulawula lizinga lekwehla kwemali eNingizimu Afrika.

Lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako libeka sisekelo sawo onkhe malizinga lentalo emnotfweni. Onkhe emabhondi, emalimboleko etimoto, emakhadi esikweleti, kanye ne-akhawunti yekonga eNingizimu Afrika ibekwe intengo ehambelana nalo.

Simo sa-2024: Lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako beliyi-8.25% kuyo yonkhe i-2024. I-SARB yayinciphisa ya-8.0% ngoSeptemba 2024 yaphinde yayinciphisa ya-7.75% ngoNovemba 2024, tekwehliswa kwekucala kusukela nga-2020, ngesikhatsi i-COVID yehlisa malizinga kuya ku-3.5%.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> is wha: Lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako yilokho le-SARB leyikhokhisisa emabhange. I-Prime = lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako + 3.5%, futsi i-prime ihamba nalinye liphuzu, ngakho kwehliswa nge-0.25% kwehlisa ibhondi liguquguqukayo nge-0.25% ngalokucondzile. Onkhe tincumo tisusa imali emkhatsini walabo lababolekako nalabo labakongako. Malizinga athinta lizinga lekwehla kwemali ngekupholisa sifiso, futsi umphumela ufika ngesikhatsi leside setinyanga.
<p>The <strong>SARB repo rate</strong> d: Lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako le-SARB likhicela tindleko takho tekuboleka. I-Prime = lizinga lentalo lebuyiswako + 3.5%, futsi tiboleko tetindlu letinyenti tibekwa ngaphansi kwe-prime. Onkhe umnyakazo we-1% kubhondi yeR1m ungaphandle kweR500/ngenyanga (≈R6 000/ngumnyaka). <p>The idea that renting is 'throwing mo:
Umbono wokuthi ukuqasha kuyimfucuza yemali ungomunye wetinganekwane temali letilimata kakhulu. Ukuqasha kuvame kuba kukhetfo loluhlakaniphe kakhulu. Uma ungahamba eminyakeni lembalwa (indleko tekuthenga tidzinga iminyaka kutsi tibuyele), uma imali yakho yediphozithi ingazuza kakhulu itsalelwe kwenye indawo, edolobheni lelinentengo lephakeme yekuthenga nokuqasha, uma ubonisa kubetela kulula, noma uma kuthenga kungakucindzetela kakhulu.

Cabanga ngenzuzo lengasasebenzi: R200 000 njengediphozithi yehlisa imali yakho yeboleko, kodvwa leyo R200 000 etaliweyo ku-~10%/ngonyaka ingakhula ibe ngange-R520 000 eminyakeni le-10. Futsi tindleko tekutfolwa kwemali yekuqukuda kwemizi ivame kuba ngaphansi kwe-6%: ngesinye sikhatsi ngaphansi kwe-akhawunti yemakethe yemali. Impendulo leqondile incike etimeni takho.

<p>When making any portfolio change, ask:

Kushintjwa kumele kusebentisele isu lakho lelitfuliwe. 'Lelisheya libonakala lincono' akusiso sizatfu sekwiphothifoliyo.

2. Uyini umbuyiso wemuva kwentela nemuva kwetindleko walencumo?
Sikhwama sa-12% nesindleko semnyaka sa-2.5% siphepha ku-9.5%. Sikhwama sa-10.5% nesindleko sa-0.3% siphepha ku-10.2%. Imikhiqizo yetindleko letinkulu ingakhombisa kuphela tidzingo tato uma ikhipha umbuyiso ngalokungaguquguquki ngendlela lengaphezu kwekwahluka kwetindleko, lokuyinto encane kakhulu yintsikazi yematfuli leyentako.

Kuhlanganiswa kwetindleko kuyalwa nawe: R100 000 ku-10% emnyakeni leyi-30 = R1 745 000. Ku-9% (indleko lephakeme nge-1%) = R1 327 000. Lowo mahluko wetindleko we-1% udla R418 000 eminyakeni leyi-30.
